rationale: Hrushikesh brings deep healthcare operations and supply chain expertise from Sharp Healthcare, while Adrish leads customer solutions for healthcare AI and analytics at Rhino Federated Computing. They can explore how data-driven analytics and optimization tools might address operational challenges in healthcare supply chains—a natural intersection of Hrushikesh's domain knowledge and Adrish's technical background.
intro_message: Hrushikesh Jadhav, meet Adrish Sannyasi — both focused on healthcare operations from different angles (supply chain vs. AI/analytics) and could discuss where these priorities overlap.
